name: Broken Blade Style (Combat, Style)
body:
Your fists strike harder than any blade.

Prerequisites: Improved Unarmed Strike, Acrobatics 3 ranks, one Broken Blade stance known.

Benefit: Your unarmed strikes ignore 1/2 your character level in damage reduction and hardness.
